noah_sales: CrownCare (enterprise, HIPAA) asking about a reserve commit. They estimate ~8M tokens/month, peak ~600 concurrent chat sessions (short 15-25min bursts), 95th <=250ms. They want reserved GPUs + burst credits and a preheat plan. Can eng/sre/pricing/security weigh in? https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-1501 :wave:

iris_eng: Quick clarifier - avg prompt+response token ~350, embeddings negligible. Model: they accept quantized open model (neoX-20B-4bit suggested).

sam_sre: Throughput ballpark: A100-ish ~130 RPS at ~350 tokens. Baseline GPUs = ceil(600/130) = 5. Add ~60% headroom for short flash windows (~20min) => +3 GPUs. Recommend reserved 5 + burst pool 3 (autoscale to 8). Spread across 2 AZs, spot allowed for burst only (cap 25%). KV cache prefill needed.

iris_eng: Suggested autoscale snippet for Dedicated config:
{
  "min_replicas": 5,
  "max_replicas": 8,
  "scale_metric": "concurrent_requests",
  "target_per_replica": 120,
  "scale_up_cooldown_s": 45,
  "scale_down_cooldown_s": 240
}

pricing_bot: Ballpark for SOW: reserved A100-equivalent $7,000/GPU-mo -> 5 * $7k = $35k baseline. Burst credits priced at ~40% of rate when consumed; if bursts used 10% of month: 3 * $7k * 0.4 * 0.1 ~= $840. Add compliance/support margin (~15%) => ~$41k/mo rough. Finance to finalize.

sec_bot: HIPAA checklist: BAA required, CMK (customer-managed KMS) for envelope encryption, VPC peering/private endpoints, audit logs export (1y retention), quarterly pen-test report. Private deployment or Dedicated + VPC peering can work. I'll attach answers to questionnaire.

noah_sales: Thanks all. I'll draft SOW with 5x reserved + 3x burst credits, include cost ballpark and security notes, and schedule a technical handoff with CrownCare for Tue 10am PT. Closing thread. :handshake:
